programme.title: Running Wild With Bear Grylls S1 Ep01

programme.title: Inside the Factory S9 Ep05
programme.desc: Paddy McGuinness and Cherry Healey visit a factory producing half a million sausage rolls a day.

programme.title: Walking With Dinosaurs S1 Ep04
programme.desc: Seventy-one million years ago lived a teenage Albertosaurus - a faster, nimbler relative of T-Rex. She had to earn her place in a deadly, ferocious pack or risk starvation.
